content.text: For ship judgement: scarian, grumbo, gembo, and jimtho c:
| Send me a ship and I'll give you my (brutally) honest opinion on it

scarian: overrated and overpopular but i clearly see why. scarian frustrates me because while i personally dont enjoy it, i also have eyes and ears. if there wasn't romantic feelings on either side at any point there was at least a mutual crush. i wouldn't put it past that crush being at different points in their lives either. smthing smthing always fated to meet but never be together or whatever

grumbo: very very good to me personally. i like that he (grian) is mean to my sweetest pea (mumbo) in a deeply repressed homosexual way. i like that mumbo is still somehow starry eyed about grian and i like that they both touched eachother during the camper van escapade.

gembo: also very good to me! also a little extra tasty only because realistically, mumbo has probably had gem flash through his mind at least once while jerking off at his desk. maybe not like full fantasy but him very briefly imagining her little sweet voice cooing at him or calling him cute or god forbid laughing at something stupid he did/said. he shakes it off because of the long term girlfriend thing but :] yeah

jimtho: i am very underqualified for my opinion on this one unfortunately. however: i think i see the appeal. dogboy/catgirl ships are usually pretty peak so i wouldnt shy away from jimtho stuff if offered more info/propaganda 👍
